How do I update my contact or account details?
You can update most contact and account details from your Account settings. Here’s how:
• Sign in to your account, then go to Account or My Profile.
• Profile/Personal details: Update your name, email address, and phone number.
• Addresses: Add, edit, or remove saved delivery addresses and set a default address.
• Password: Change your password (or use “Forgot password” on the sign‑in page if you can’t log in).
• Communication preferences: Update your marketing/email preferences.
• Payment methods (if shown): Add or remove saved cards.
If you checked out as a guest, you can create an account using the same email you used at checkout to see your orders and manage details going forward.

Can I change the payment method on my order?
Short answer: the payment method on an existing order can’t be changed once it’s placed.
Your options:
• If it’s still within the short cancellation window, we can cancel the order so you can place a new one with your preferred payment method.
• If the order has moved into preparation/dispatch or has shipped, it can’t be changed or cancelled.
Refunds for cancelled orders go back to the original payment method. Card refunds typically show in 3–5 business days (some banks up to 10); wallets like PayPal/Apple Pay/Google Pay are often 1–3 business days.
